comparison_lanes.PV_GEOMETRIC_RESPONSE: prescribed a_i^B=a_bar*exp(beta_i), sum beta=0; a_i^F=a_bar, beta(t0)=0; same proper-time endpoints and volume dilution
comparison_lanes.EC_SELF_CONSISTENT: future Einstein-solved lane; same H,matter,Lambda and nonzero shear cannot all be imposed; not executed

paired_inputs: atomic function realization including cooling derivatives
not_paired_by_force: point source values at different temperatures

angular_contract.six_axes: not M4 exact; negative control for intended isotropic continuum
angular_contract.isotropic14: six axes weight1/15 each; eight normalized cube corners weight3/40 each
angular_contract.orientation_test: rotate quadrature relative to metric axes

spectral_contract: refine within the same physical spectrum; delta lines and finite-width bands are distinct models; preserve all threshold crossings

smooth_nulls.scalar_first_variation: zero for initially isotropic rotationally-equivariant smooth fixed-volume evolution
smooth_nulls.scalar_evenness: not generic; cubic tr(B^3) is allowed
smooth_nulls.no_unchecked_extension: threshold crossings, anisotropic initial data, unpaired sources or fixed observed-z surfaces

observed_surface.multiple_time_roots: enumerate or reject ambiguity, never endpoint-only detection
